infotexts.jobdescription.PlayerHuskJob: A rotting corpse stuffed into an ancient diver's suit, it drifted in through the airlock and never bothered to leave. No one knows what it wants—if it even wants anything at all. It lingers in the corridors, occasionally twitching, occasionally drooling a dark, viscous fluid that smells faintly of brine. Some say it clicks softly at night, a hollow sound that rattles the bulkheads. Whatever it once was, now it’s something else, and it’s decided to stay.
infotexts.talentdescription.symbiosis: While near friends, they gain [stun]% stun resistance and damage resistance. Whenever you heal an ally, you also heal yourself for [healing]% of that amount.
infotexts.talentdescription.feelsweirdman: While near friends, they gain [bleedResistance]% bleed resistance and reduce bleeding wound duration by [bleedWound]%.
infotexts.talentdescription.bestfriends1: While near friends, they gain [burn]% burn and acid resistance, plus [psychosis]% psychosis resistance.
infotexts.talentdescription.bestfriends2: Biting allies who are not already infected heals them for [heal].
infotexts.talentdescription.lackofheart1: While near allies, they consume [oxygen]% less oxygen.
infotexts.talentdescription.lackofheart2: [items] can heal any limb injury for [heal]. This effect is tripled on allies without Husk infection.
infotexts.talentdescription.lackofheart3: Unlock [item] that can be used every 5 minutes to extract [egg].
infotexts.talentdescription.slipstreamsecretion1: While near allies, everyone gains [speed]% swim speed.
infotexts.talentdescription.slipstreamsecretion2: When alone in water, you take [damage]% more damage.
infotexts.talentdescription.guardianangel: When you take damage, all nearby allies take [damage]% less damage for [duration] seconds.
infotexts.talentdescription.overcooked: Gain a [damage]% reduction to all damage.
infotexts.talentdescription.refeeding: Biting enemies heals you [healing]% more and deals [damage]% more damage to them.
infotexts.talentdescription.rupturedskin: When you take melee damage, you have a [chance]% chance to make the attacker bleed for [bleed].
infotexts.talentdescription.toxiceggs: Biting enemies deals [acidDamage] acid damage and [bleedDamage] bleed damage. Increases your bite damage by [damage]%.
infotexts.talentdescription.toxicstingers: Using [item] causes the target to take [acidDamage] acid damage and [bleedDamage] bleed damage. Increases [item] damage by [damage]%.
infotexts.talentdescription.pheromones: All feral husks perceive everyone in your close proximity, including you, as a fellow husk.
infotexts.talentdescription.carnophage: Gain [healing]% health whenever you use melee weapons.
infotexts.talentdescription.weldedfibers: Increases mechanical and electrical repair speed by [speed]% and boosts related skills by [skill].
infotexts.talentdescription.hingedcarapace: Adds a [chance]% chance to deflect incoming damage.
infotexts.talentdescription.moldedhide: Adds [damage]% damage reduction against gunshot wounds.
infotexts.talentdescription.bioelasticmuscles: When you melee-attack an enemy at full health, you deal [damage]% additional damage.
infotexts.talentdescription.exosuit_transform: The flesh is weak. Enter an Exosuit to achieve full mecha-morphosis.
infotexts.talentdescription.chimera_crushinglimbs: When under the effect of steroids, your oversized limbs have a [chance]% chance to stun enemies you hit with melee attacks.
infotexts.talentdescription.chimera_feralstance: Enter a feral rage for [duration] seconds when you take damage. Gain [damageReduction]% damage reduction and [stunResistance]% stun resistance, but your movement speed is reduced by [speedPenalty]%.
infotexts.talentdescription.chimera_bonemoldedplat: Gain a [deflectionChance]% chance to deflect bullets and melee attacks.
infotexts.talentdescription.chimera_chitinoushusk: Reduce incoming bleed and burn damage by [reduction]%.
infotexts.talentdescription.chimera_gravemight: When your health drops below [threshold]%, gain a burst of strength, increasing your melee damage by [damage]%.
infotexts.talentdescription.chimera_horridvisage: ,Your terrifying appearance reduces a monster's attack speed by [reducedAttackSpeed]% for 5 seconds after you hit it with melee.
infotexts.talentdescription.chimera_transform: ,The flesh is total domination. Borrow a friend's body and inject them with the husk-slug to complete this transformation.
infotexts.talentdescription.prowler_transform: By ragdolling for 10 seconds, you morph into a prowler or revert to husk. You can do this once every 60 seconds.
infotexts.talentdescription.prowler_speeddemon: Your base speed is reduced by [reducedSpeed]%. When on hyperzine, your sprint speed is greatly increased by [speed]%.
infotexts.talentdescription.prowler_tendonflex: Your limber limbs grant [speed]% increased sprint speed.
infotexts.talentdescription.prowler_serratedclaws: Your claws cause deep wounds. Melee applies a bleed effect of [bleed].
infotexts.talentdescription.prowler_swolearms: When under the effect of steroids, your bite damage is increased by [damage]%.
infotexts.talentdescription.EndOfTheLine: Do not pick this skill, you will be killed and lose a skillpoint.
infotexts.entitydescription.hh_brainslug: A grotesque mass of pulsating goop, what is it for?
infotexts.entitydescription.hh_eggextractor: A medieval tool for extracting eggs from a live friendly husk. Could be lethal if abused.
infotexts.fabricationdescription.hh_eggextractor_r: A medieval tool for extracting eggs from a live friendly husk. Could be lethal if abused.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.HHSymbiosisBuff: A layer of strange, clingy ooze coats your skin. It's warm, rubbery, and it won't wipe off. You feel oddly bolstered beneath its slimy embrace, but your stomach turns at the thought of what it's made from.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.HHFeelsWeirdManBuf: Your wounds are patched by some stringy, congealed matter that smells faintly of rotting kelp. It's sealing you up, yes, but at what cost? The thought of foreign flesh melded with yours is unsettling.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.HHBestFriendsBuff: A viscous film spreads across your suit and skin, giving a slight reprieve from acid, burns, and madness. Yet, the protective film writhes subtly, as if alive. The comfort feels hollow, as if you're complicit in something unspeakable.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.HHLackOfHeartBuff: A muffled rasp haunts your ears as you inhale. The air is oddly dense, but easier to breathe. A chill seeps into your lungs, as though something else is breathing through you, helping you persist… but why?
infotexts.afflictiondescription.HHSlipstreamSecret: Your movements become strangely fluid, as if oily tendrils guide your limbs. It's as if some foul membrane coats your joints, easing your motion while reminding you that you're not moving alone.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.HHGuardianAngelBuf: Something pulses beneath your skin when danger strikes. You endure blows more easily, yet the sensation of tugging, throbbing flesh that isn't yours fills you with a twisted gratitude and lingering nausea.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.HHExtractedEggsDeb: Someone has forcibly extracted your eggs, you will need time to regenerate or risk dying.
